label: PF Backlog 456
title: PF: assignments view + assignment-time dedup guard
body:
Child of the parallel-run-engine epic. Visibility + the duplicate-work guard for parallel assignment.

Scope: (1) GET /api/v1/engineering/assignments - active assignments (item, worker, phase, lease_expires_at),
a thin read-model over backlog.execution{} + job_manager; (2) /wg status proxies it (N workers, each on which
item); (3) assignment-time DEDUP guard: at claim/eligibility, skip/flag an item that near-duplicates an
already-active (or higher-priority open) item - reuse backlog.duplicate_pairs/find_similar (no new logic).

Why: same-item double-assignment and path-overlap are already prevented (scheduler.eligible + ENG-8
reservations); near-duplicate ITEMS are not, and parallel assignment raises that risk.

Descriptors: module:core/scheduler.py; module:core/backlog.py; module:api/routers/engineering.py;
test:test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_assignment_dedup.py; route:GET /api/v1/engineering/assignments.

## Scope amendment (2026-10-07, Reconciliation rule)
D1: the `/wg status` proxy moves to BI-PF-0423 (WorkerGrid thin client). BI-PF-0422 delivers the PF
`GET /engineering/assignments` view + the claim-time dedup guard (Option A) only.
Split: near-duplicate ENFORCEMENT at pickup = this item (A). Whole-backlog near-duplicate MARKING at grooming
= BI-PF-0432 (B). A is the runtime guard; B is the grooming-time marking pass.

delivery.note: merged --no-ff; fast precheck PASS. GET /engineering/assignments (read-model over item.execution{}); claim-time dedup guard in scheduler.next_eligible(stage=execute) skips a near-duplicate of an active/higher-ranked open item (default threshold 0.6, env PF_DEDUP_THRESHOLD); new test_assignment_dedup.py (3). Also classified BRANCHING-GIT-WORKFLOW.md in gen_docs_index.py (docs-fresh drift from BI-PF-0431). Option B (whole-backlog dedup marking at grooming) = BI-PF-0432.

decisions.decision: A only in 0422 (claim-time skip); /wg proxy -> 0423; whole-backlog marking -> B (BI-PF-0432)
